description:
Unlock Success | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of Bright Sitar to Start the Week

Monday does not have to begin heavy. If the week already feels like a wall before you have stood up, let the first ninety minutes be bright instead: clear head, loose shoulders, a little momentum.

This uplifting Indian sitar music is designed to lift your energy without rushing you - warm, forward-moving and steady, the kind of morning where things start to open.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm plucked sitar with soft tabla over a gentle drone, a flowing steady pulse and no vocals.

▶ Keep the momentum — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for Monday mornings, a fresh start, getting ready for work, morning walks, journaling, yoga flow, cooking breakfast, a bright commute, creative work, or any moment you want to feel unblocked.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sitar with light tabla and tanpura
Raga: Ahir Bhairav (a dawn raga - grounded, hopeful)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, uplifting
Mood: Bright, clear, quietly confident
Atmosphere: First sun on a rooftop, the day still open
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Press play as you get up and let the pulse set your pace for the first hour. Keep it on through breakfast and the first task of the day. Headphones bring out the sitar's warmth; speakers work beautifully in a kitchen or studio.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 A clear beginning
9:00 Light comes in
18:00 Momentum, unhurried
27:00 Doors opening
36:00 Bright and steady
45:00 The day takes shape
54:00 Warm confidence
1:03:00 Clear head, open path
1:12:00 Carrying it forward
1:21:00 Ready for the week

⏱ BEST FOR
• Monday and fresh-start mornings
• Getting ready for work
• Morning walks and stretching
• Journaling and planning
• Creative and focused work
• Cooking and household mornings
• Yoga flow
• A positive commute
• Lifting a flat mood
• Background energy for the home

If this music gave your morning a lift, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
